dedupe_keys.name: machine learning inference limits of routine cement characterization for cem i performance analysis code

description: The cement-analysis author publishes Python code and four executed Jupyter notebooks for testing what routine cement measurements can predict about CEM I performance. Zenodo provides a ZIP under MIT. The described workflow constructs a CEM I cohort from the separately deposited processed dataset, runs regressions and producer-holdout evaluation, aggregates SHAP values and reproduces specified tables and figures. It can benchmark material-property inference before using predicted cement strengths in structural simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this analysis package. Coverage is the CEM I subset and published laboratory data, not an independently validated model for every cement producer. A limitation is that source workbooks and internal cement-code matches are withheld; one figure is distributed only as a static image because its supplementary source is restricted. The page says the README specifies dataset placement and notebook order, but the archive was not downloaded. Python 3.11 or later is recommended; no notebook was executed.
